FLEETING_WEBSITE.description: Canonical URL of the website, affects OpenGraph card URL and client URL for authentication

FLEETING_PRIVACY_POLICY_URL.description: URL of the privacy policy page

FLEETING_TRANSLANG_INSTANCES.description: Space-separated list of Translang instances for translation

FLEETING_DEFAULT_LANG.description: Default language fallback after multiple detection methods

FLEETING_DEFAULT_INSTANCE_REGISTRATION_U.description: URL of the instance registration page

FLEETING_REFERRER_POLICY.description: Referrer policy for the site, applied with meta tag on client-side

FLEETING_IMG_ALT_API_URL.description: API endpoint for self-hosted img-alt-api instance

FLEETING_DISALLOW_ROBOTS.description: Set to any value to disallow all web crawlers from indexing the site
